note: Lessons -> rules loop. Each post-mortem proposes at most 3 rules for the next week; Andy accepts them. Cash tickets only; promo/bonus/free-bet tickets are exempt. Managed by reports/bets/season-recap/scripts/rules.py.

rules.text: Max 3-4 legs per cash ticket (6+ leg stacks are promo/bonus only)
One read on at most 2-3 cash tickets
rules.source: Week 8 post-mortem (Okonkwo receptions x5, Warren receiving x4)

rules.text: Prefer rushing-lane legs; receiving props at the lowest rung offered
rules.check_note: Proxy: flags a receiving leg on a cash ticket when the same player/market appears at a lower rung on another ticket that week.

rules.text: No totals or same-team prop stacks on a shaky-QB game until inactives are out
rules.source: Week 8 post-mortem (Lamar left BAL@BUF on the first series)
